business_summary: The Beachbody Company, Inc. operates as a fitness and nutrition company in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and France. The company operates Beachbody on Demand Interactive, a streaming service through subscription that provides fitness and nutrition content, including P90X, Insanity, 21 Day Fix, 80 Day Obsession, Morning Meltdown 100, LIIFT4, Unstress Meditations, Portion Fix, 4 Weeks of Focus, Sure Thing, Dig Deeper, Track Pilate, 2B Mindset, Insanity, P90X, Yoga52, and other brands. It also provides nutritional products, such as Shakeology, a nutrition shake; and Beachbody Performance supplements comprising pre-workout energize, hydrate, post-workout recover. The Beachbody Company, Inc. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in El Segundo, California.
business_summary_ko: Beachbody Company, Inc.는 미국, 캐나다, 영국 및 프랑스에서 피트니스 및 영양 회사로 운영되고 있습니다. 이 회사는 구독을 통해 P90X, Insanity, 21 Day Fix, 80 Day Obsession, Morning Meltdown 100, LIIFT4, Unstress Meditations, Portion Fix, 4 Weeks of Focus, Sure Thing, Dig Deeper, Track Pilate, 2B Mindset, Insanity, P90X, Yoga52 및 기타 브랜드를 포함한 피트니스 및 영양 콘텐츠를 제공하는 스트리밍 서비스인 Beachbody on Demand Interactive를 운영합니다. 또한 영양 쉐이크인 Shakeology와 같은 영양 제품도 제공합니다. 운동 전 활력 공급, 수분 공급, 운동 후 회복으로 구성된 Beachbody Performance 보충제. Beachbody Company, Inc.는 1998년에 설립되었으며 캘리포니아 엘 세군도에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
